Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCRA TIFR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026 is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Engineer (Electronics) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for various posts, including Project Engineer (Electronics), Engineer Trainee (Electronics), and Lab. Assistant Trainee (Electronics) in the NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Engineer (Electronics)?
faq.answer: For the Project Engineer (Electronics) post, candidates need a Full Time Degree in Engineering (B.E/B.Tech with aggregate of 60% marks) in Electronics or an allied field, along with 0-3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts in the NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026 is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary varies for each post. Project Engineer (Electronics) can earn up to Rs. 88,300/-, Engineer Trainee (Electronics) up to Rs. 35,000/-, and Lab. Assistant Trainee (Electronics) up to Rs. 18,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates must visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these posts is Ooty, Tamil Nadu, as indicated in the recruitment details. Candidates should be willing to work in this location.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The posts advertised under NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026 are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It is recommended to download and read the PDF thoroughly before applying.
